name: Capesize
suitability: Heavy coal, iron ore. Best for Paradip & Gangavaram deep berths only.

name: Panamax
suitability: Coal, grains. Highly versatile, accepted at most East Coast ports.

name: Supramax / Ultramax
suitability: Bulk cargo, gears onboard. Excellent for smaller draft ports like Haldia.

name: Handysize
suitability: General dry bulk. Essential for Sagar-Sandheads lighterage and Haldia.
